_comment: Remote tuning of CutCount. Host this file publicly (python tools/build.py --site puts it in dist/site/config.json: https://cutcountasmr.github.io/config.json), put its address in src/ids.js CONFIG_URL, then edit the numbers here: players get them at their next launch, no app update. Keys and defaults: TUNE in src/meta.js (MONETISATION.md section 9). Unknown keys or wrong types are ignored. piecesPc / piecesPhone / piecesMobile: the most pieces a fruit is cut into on a PC, a strong phone, another phone (0: the build's own, 14,000 / 7,000 / 1,000; at most 16,000).
